one_liner: Marketplace for creators to sell digital products, memberships, and physical goods.

evidence.claim: Any signed-in Gumroad user can self-serve API credentials by creating an application in advanced settings and clicking 'Generate access token'.
evidence.quote: First, sign in to your Gumroad account. Then, go to advanced settings. Here, you'll see a form to create a new application.

evidence.claim: Personal access tokens can be generated manually without a full OAuth flow.
evidence.quote: if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token, which is a simpler process

evidence.claim: Full OAuth2 authorization-code flow is supported for third-party apps acting on any Gumroad account.
evidence.quote: send the user to Gumroad for authorization using a URL like this: https://gumroad.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=CLIENT_ID&redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI&scope=SCOPE

evidence.claim: The API is a versioned REST API (v2) over https://api.gumroad.com with token passed per request.
API surface covers products, sales, subscribers, and license verify/enable/disable operations.
evidence.quote: Connect with Gumroad API and get get products, sales, subscribers, verify licence with simple HTTP REST API.

notes: Access tokens never expire until manually revoked ('we do not expire the access_token until it is revoked manually'). OAuth scopes like 'edit_products' imply write endpoints beyond reads. Multiple community MCP servers exist (keithah/gumroad-mcp, rmarescu/gumroad-mcp) but none are shipped by Gumroad/antiwork itself, so official_mcp=false.
